name: What is the difference between a custom shower and a pre-fabricated shower?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom shower and a pre-fabricated shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom shower is built on-site, allowing for unique dimensions, tile patterns, and fixture placements, offering maximum personalization and design flexibility. This option is ideal for unusual spaces or specific aesthetic visions. Pre-fabricated showers, on the other hand, are manufactured off-site and installed as a single unit or a few large panels. They are typically more budget-friendly and quicker to install, but offer fewer design choices. Your choice depends on your budget, design preferences, and bathroom layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom showers offer unique design flexibility built on-site, while pre-fabricated showers are budget-friendly, quicker to install units with fewer design options.
